name: Poor Old Blanchy
summary: Verna Furlbrow waits beside the road in Westfall with her stranded family and starving mare. Their wagon broke during an attempt to escape, leaving Old Blanchy exhausted. Verna asks you to gather oats from nearby abandoned farmsteads and feed the old horse.

sections.title: A Stranded Household
sections.body: Verna and Farmer Furlbrow are stranded beside Westfall's main road. Bandits and rogue mechanical harvest golems have driven families like theirs from their homes. As the Furlbrows tried to haul their belongings to safety, their wagon broke down, leaving them marooned in open country.

sections.title: Comfort for a Faithful Mare
sections.body: Old Blanchy has plowed and hauled for the Furlbrow family across many seasons. Now exhausted from pulling their overloaded cart and starved by the delay, the gentle mare is fading fast. Verna asks you to search nearby overrun farmsteads for sacks of oats, where hostile threshers and gnoll scavengers threaten. The grain could give the faithful animal a decent meal.

faq.answer: Old Blanchy is the Furlbrow family's beloved, aging workhorse. She has pulled their plows and carts across Westfall for years, and now she is exhausted and stranded beside the road after their wagon axle broke.

faq.q: Why is the Furlbrow wagon broken down?
faq.answer: The Furlbrows tried to flee their farm with all their belongings, but their wagon gave out under the strain. They are stranded along the highway, exposed to bandits and prowling beasts.

faq.q: Where do the oats come from?
faq.answer: Sacks of oats lie scattered across the fields and outbuildings of Westfall's overrun farmsteads, left behind when homesteaders fled rogue harvest machines and bandits.

faq.q: What threats guard the grain in the fields?
faq.answer: The fields southwest of the road are troubled by rogue mechanical harvest watchers and bands of Riverpaw gnolls scavenging in deserted barns.

faq.q: Why hasn't the family moved Old Blanchy to safety?
faq.answer: Old Blanchy is spent and starving, unable to pull or travel far without sustenance. The Furlbrows refuse to leave behind their loyal mare or their belongings.

faq.q: Does Stormwind send aid to farmers like the Furlbrows?
faq.answer: Stormwind's royal court offers Westfall's homesteaders almost no protection or aid. Rural folk are largely left to fend for themselves or rely on the struggling People's Militia.

angles.text: The stranded Furlbrows show how rural human subjects suffer neglect while the capital remains paralyzed by political stagnation.
As a hunter, you know that caring for a spent draft animal honors the bond between working folk and the beasts that faithfully bear their burdens.
